caption:
OpenAI is rolling out Slides inside ChatGPT.
It builds a deck from a chat, your files or an outline, and your team can edit it together in real time.
Decks export to PowerPoint, PDF and Google Slides.

Would you let ChatGPT make your next presentation?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: Superpower Daily · Photo: Tech Journal

slides.headline: ChatGPT now builds your slide deck, and *your whole team can edit it live*

slides.heading: A deck from *one chat*
paras: OpenAI started rolling out ChatGPT Slides on October 16. It builds a presentation from a conversation, uploaded files or an outline.
You can also hand it an example deck, and it follows that deck's style and layout.

slides.heading: Edit it *by hand or by asking*
paras: Change text, images, shapes and charts directly, or just tell ChatGPT what to fix. You can generate custom images or add your own.
On mobile you can create slides through chat and view decks, but not edit each element directly.

slides.heading: Built for *teams*
paras: Colleagues edit the same deck at the same time inside Space, ChatGPT's shared workspace, and leave comments for each other.
When it is ready, you can present the deck right inside ChatGPT.

slides.heading: Straight *to PowerPoint*
paras: On the web, decks export to PowerPoint, PDF or Google Slides. The desktop app opens them in PowerPoint or Keynote if you have them installed.

paras.t: For now it is only for eligible Pro, Business and Enterprise users with Space access.

slides.hook: OpenAI just walked into Microsoft's office software turf. Follow to see who wins your workday.
